verdict.rationale: Formant documents event-driven automations that run without a human in the loop: events can trigger commands such as running a script on the device, events can fire webhooks to any HTTP endpoint, and the operations product is pitched as automating incident response and monitoring workflows. The evidence is only a few brief mentions, and its AI-driven task recommendations explicitly require people to approve what happens next. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring automations (only one-off event triggers are shown), in-depth docs on configuring and managing background workflows, autonomous AI-agent execution without human approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
